title: EpistemicAtlas
description: Schema for a structured epistemic knowledge base representing a real-world dispute.

id.description: Unique kebab-case identifier for this atlas entry.

domain.description: Primary knowledge domain (e.g., particle physics, nutrition science, climate science).

status.description: Current epistemic status of the dispute.

data_status.description: Whether the entry data has been verified against primary sources. 'sample' = illustrative only, 'partial' = some claims verified, 'verified' = all claims checked.

summary.description: Neutral description of the dispute (2-5 sentences, no position taken).

created.description: Date this atlas entry was created.

updated.description: Date this atlas entry was last updated.

sources.description: All sources consulted. Low-credibility sources are included, not discarded.

credibility.description: Initial credibility assessment based on venue, methodology disclosure, and conflicts of interest.

conflict_of_interest.description: Known or suspected conflicts of interest (funding source, institutional affiliation, etc.).

claims.description: Atomic, normalized epistemic claims extracted from sources.

raw.description: Verbatim text or close paraphrase from the source.

normalized.description: Standardized, unambiguous restatement with explicit scope, quantification, and referents.

source_id.description: ID of the source this claim is drawn from.

position.description: Position of this claim relative to the main dispute. 'pro' = supports the primary risk/concern position; 'con' = contradicts or undermines it; 'neutral' = background fact; 'conditional' = depends on conditions not yet resolved; 'methodological' = a claim about how to evaluate evidence.

domain_type.description: What kind of claim this is.

notes.description: Explanation of the confidence level assignment.

failure_flags.description: Epistemic failure modes identified in this specific claim.

data_status.description: Overrides the entry-level data_status for this specific claim if different.

relations.description: Logical and evidential relationships between claims.

type.description: supports: A provides evidence or justification for B. attacks: A contradicts or undermines B. depends_on: A is only meaningful if B is true. qualifies: A narrows B's scope without contradicting it. implies: A logically entails B. is_crux_of: A is a pivotal load-bearing claim for B.

cruxes.description: Pivotal claims whose resolution would significantly change the dispute.

statement.description: A single clear question or proposition that is the crux.

description.description: Why this is a crux: what changes if it is resolved true vs. false.

dependent_claim_ids.description: Claims that depend on this crux.

resolution_notes.description: How and by what evidence the crux was resolved, if applicable.

missing_evidence.description: Evidence that does not currently exist but whose existence would change the epistemic status of at least one crux or claim.

description.description: What the missing evidence is and why it is absent.

would_affect_ids.description: IDs of claims or cruxes that this evidence would affect.

priority.description: How significantly this evidence gap limits resolution of the dispute.

assessment.description: Overall epistemic assessment of the dispute.

epistemic_status.description: Plain-language summary of the current epistemic state of the dispute.

resolved.description: Whether the central dispute has a clear resolution supported by strong evidence.

resolution_summary.description: If resolved, what the resolution is and what resolved it.

well_supported_claim_ids.description: Claims with high or medium confidence and no significant attacks.

failure_modes_observed.description: Epistemic failure modes identified anywhere in this entry.

notes.description: Any additional epistemic notes not captured elsewhere.
